name: Paris & French Riviera
summary: Eight days across France's two icons: four nights in Paris for the Eiffel Tower, Louvre, Montmartre and a Versailles day trip, then the fast train south for three nights on the Riviera — Nice's promenade, the perched village of Èze, and an afternoon in Monaco. City art up north, Mediterranean light down south.
highlights: Eiffel Tower summit and an evening Seine cruise
Louvre and Versailles with pre-planned timed entries
TGV journey from Paris to the Riviera
Èze village and Monte-Carlo corniche day trip

itinerary.title: Bonjour Paris
itinerary.description: Arrive, check-in, and an easy first walk — Champs-Élysées to the Arc de Triomphe as the lights come on.

itinerary.title: Louvre & the Seine
itinerary.description: Timed-entry morning at the Louvre, Île de la Cité and the restored Notre-Dame from the outside, evening cruise on the Seine.

itinerary.title: Eiffel Tower & Montmartre
itinerary.description: Summit lifts at the Eiffel Tower, afternoon climb through Montmartre to Sacré-Cœur and the artists' square.

itinerary.title: Versailles
itinerary.description: Day trip to Louis XIV's palace — Hall of Mirrors, royal apartments and the fountain gardens.

itinerary.title: South to the Riviera
itinerary.description: TGV through the French countryside to Nice; sunset stroll on the Promenade des Anglais.

itinerary.title: Èze & Monaco
itinerary.description: Corniche drive to the medieval perched village of Èze, then Monte-Carlo — casino square, harbour and the famous F1 corners.

itinerary.title: Nice old town
itinerary.description: Cours Saleya flower market, old-town lanes and a proper Mediterranean beach afternoon — or an optional Cannes/Antibes run.

itinerary.title: Au revoir
itinerary.description: Breakfast by the sea, transfer to Nice airport for departure.
